title: Nvidia Q3 FY27: the margin steps down
sources: Nvidia Q3 FY27 release (17 Nov 2026) and Q2 FY27 outlook; Q3 FY27 earnings call via ValueAdd VC and The Singju Post

slides.title: 74.8% gross margin.
slides.sub: The chip layer's margin, in 6 slides.

slides.label: Revenue, up 103% on a year ago
slides.note: Nvidia had guided $108.0bn, plus or minus 2%.

slides.title: Read the guide
points: Q4 guide: $130bn of revenue at a 71% to 72% margin. Q4 has one extra week.
On the call, the CFO said Q4 should be the low point, with 72% to 73% expected in fiscal 2028.
